name: Seed Grant
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide seeds to farmers at a concessional rate during Kisan Melas with a subsidy of up to 15%.
descriptionMd: The “Seed Grant” scheme is implemented by Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar, under the Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to support farmers by providing seeds at a 15% subsidy during Kisan Melas through direct distribution to them.
benefitsMd: Farmers are provided seeds at a subsidy of up to 15% during Kisan Melas.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a farmer.
applicationMd: All farmers are provided seeds during Kisan Melas on the basis of availability.
